plan.notes: Official CMCC 2026-2027 online catalog (the controlling catalog), Associate in Science in Business Transfer — the transfer pathway into business-related bachelor's programs (accounting, business administration, finance, marketing, etc.). Catalog name for the program is 'Business Transfer (BUS)'. Choice slots modeled at first-listed option's credits: ENG 101 (3) over ENG 105 (4); ENG 201 over ENG 220. With ENG 105 instead of ENG 101 the program totals 62 credits. A minimum of 12 Advising Pathway credits is required; pathway electives not declared as a pathway may be filled with general education electives or any ACC, BCA, or BUS course.
